title: Descrição da Fase de Ação — p. 100
scopeLimits: This batch covers only the Action Phase explanation below its separate heading on page 100.
The body is tied to its three source-backed visual baselines; no hard breaks, font changes, or frame edits are introduced.
Original OptimaLTStd 9 pt style and the two bold SP abbreviations are preserved.
Fase de Ação and Fase de Fim do Turno remain local candidates until editorial approval.

candidates.sourceText: During the Action Phase, an Adventurer may spend SP to take Actions and/or use Abilities. When they decide they no longer want to spend SP or take Actions and/or use Abilities, the Adventure continues to the End of Turn Phase.
candidates.proposalText: Durante a Fase de Ação, o Aventureiro pode gastar SP para realizar Ações e/ou usar Habilidades. Quando não quiser mais gastar SP, realizar Ações ou usar Habilidades, a Aventura segue para a Fase de Fim do Turno.

pendingTerms: Action Phase → Fase de Ação, End of Turn Phase → Fase de Fim do Turno, and Adventure → Aventura are local candidates pending editorial approval.
Stamina Points remains abbreviated as source SP.

copyfitMeasurement.method: scripts/measure_copyfit_page.mjs: PyMuPDF spans are first grouped by their source line object, then distinct source lines are grouped by representative baseline (1 pt tolerance). Rich runs in one line object remain one visual row. Inline uppercase callout markers and a separate Cinzel quantity glyph beside a declared weapon-hand symbol are folded into the adjacent prose row only when their ink boxes overlap. Live PT-BR PageRenderer text rects plus visible semantic-symbol rects for symbol-only rows are clustered by vertical centre (0.5 x median rect height); inline symbols overlapping a text row count with that row, not as extra lines. Candidate text and symbol IDs must match the selected renderer unit. For image-backed/raster-restored source text whose PDF extraction is incomplete, a candidate-scoped sourceVisualLineCountOverride may be used only with documented visual evidence. No character count, string newline count or frame-height estimate was used.
